name: cut-opens-its-own-cavity
why: A multi-tool cut is one boolean, judged on its result. The cavity is listed before the bore that opens it; checked after each tool, the cavity alone was a sealed void and the cut was refused, while cut(bore, cavity) built the same part — order-dependence measured on a lamp shade. Every number here is closed form: 40·40·30 − 30·30·24 − π·4²·3 = 26249.204 mm³; area 8000 + 4680 − 2·16π + 24π = 12654.87 mm²; the bore opens both faces it crosses, so one body and no void. See docs/GOTCHAS.md, "A multi-tool cut is one cut".
